titulo_es.@es: La voz pasiva: se hace, se construyó
titulo_es.@en: The passive voice: it is made, it was built

texto.@es: **am / is / are + participio**: **The windows are cleaned every week** (las ventanas se limpian cada semana). La forma de **be** concuerda con el sujeto: **is** con singular, **are** con plural.
texto.@en: **am / is / are + participio**: **The windows are cleaned every week** (windows are cleaned every week). The **be** shape matches the subject: **is** with singular, **are** with plural.

texto.@es: **was / were + participio**: **This house was built in 1900** (esta casa se construyó en 1900); **The bridge was opened in 1950** (el puente se abrió en 1950). Usa **was** con singular y **were** con plural.
texto.@en: **was / were + participio**: **This house was built in 1900** (this house was built in 1900); **The bridge was opened in 1950** (the bridge was opened in 1950). Use **was** with singular and **were** with plural.

texto.@es: Los participios regulares suelen terminar en **-ed**: **cleaned**, **closed**, **painted**. Algunos son irregulares: **build → built**, **speak → spoken**. Para nombrar quién realiza la acción, añade **by**: **built by my family** (construida por mi familia).
texto.@en: Regular participles usually end up in **-ed**: **cleaned**, **closed**, **painted**. Some are irregular: **build → built**, **speak → spoken**. To name who does the action, add **by**: **built by my family** (built by my family).

frases.en: Yes, it was painted last year.
frases.es: Sí, se pintó el año pasado.

frases.en: The windows are cleaned every week.
frases.es: Las ventanas se limpian cada semana.

frases.en: The garden is opened to visitors every summer.
frases.es: El jardín se abre al público cada verano.

frases.en: Is the door locked at night?
frases.es: ¿Se cierra la puerta con llave por la noche?

frases.en: Yes, it is locked by my family.
frases.es: Sí, mi familia la cierra con llave.

analisis.@es: cerrada con llave por mi familia

frases.en: It was built by my family.

pregunta.@es: ¿Qué forma va en **The house ___ built in 1900**?
pregunta.@en: What's the way in **The house ___ built in 1900**?

explicacion.@en: It's used with a plural subject.

explicacion.@es: Es presente, pero la acción ocurrió en 1900.
explicacion.@en: It is present, but the action occurred in 1900.

pregunta.@es: ¿Cuál es la forma pasiva correcta de **They built the bridge**?
pregunta.@en: What is the correct passive form of **They built the bridge**?

explicacion.@en: **Was + participio**; the agent may be omitted.

bloques.frase: The windows are cleaned every week.

opciones.texto: Las ventanas se limpian cada semana.

explicacion.@es: **Are cleaned** = se limpian; presente pasivo plural.
explicacion.@en: **Are cleaned** = are cleaned; present plural liabilities.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería activa y falta el objeto.
explicacion.@en: That would be active and missing the object.

bloques.frase: The house was ___ by my family.

explicacion.@en: It is used with singular subject.

bloques.frase: The garden is opened to visitors every summer

traduccion.@es: El jardín se abre al público cada verano
traduccion.@en: The garden opens to the public every summer

explicacion.@es: **Is + participio** forma el presente pasivo singular.
explicacion.@en: **Is + participio** forms the present liability singular.

pregunta.@es: ¿Cómo dices «Las puertas se pintaron el año pasado»?
pregunta.@en: What do you mean, «The doors were painted last year.»?

respuestas: The doors were painted last year.

explicacion.@en: Plural subject in the past: **were + participio**.

intro.@es: La pasiva centra la frase en la persona o cosa que recibe la acción. A veces no decimos quién la hace; si importa, podemos añadirlo con **by**.
intro.@en: The passive focuses the phrase on the person or thing that receives the action. Sometimes we don't say who does it; if it matters, we can add it with **by**.
